purpose: Complete Phase 3 of #5111 by normalizing every remaining homepage-reachable public surface onto the canonical public shell, removing visitor-facing status/readiness presentation, correcting inherited public metadata framing, and resolving responsive/floating-shell inconsistencies without changing authentication, registration authority, AI gateway authority or legal-consent authority.
effectiveAfter: This independent governance PR is reviewed and merged to main. The implementation branch must then be created or rematerialized from the accepted exact main containing this manifest; implementation must not widen its own scope.
requiredInvariants: This is public presentation and acceptance scope only. Personal cabinets, protected runtime, API, database, tenant, RBAC, registration authority, authentication authority, consent authority, release authority and production topology are unchanged.

The canonical PublicSiteHeader remains the single website header geometry authority. Gekta may retain its internal chat-workspace toolbar as product UI, but the public discovery surface must use the canonical website header and must not introduce a second competing public-site header.

PublicContactDock becomes the single responsive geometry authority for the canonical public contact dock. At <=767px the floating dock may collapse to one >=44px Gekta/assistant action while support and phone actions are hidden from that floating dock. At >=1180px, where exact browser evidence shows the default 304-334px horizontal dock can cover form or reading content, it may retain all three existing actions in a narrow >=44px vertical icon rail. PublicContactDock changes are presentation-only: assistant/support trigger selectors, phone destination, modal behavior, focus return and action semantics remain unchanged.

apps/web/styles/platform-v7-international-home-fix.css is in scope only to retire its duplicated .pc-public-contact-dock mobile, >=1180px desktop, reduced-motion and forced-colors geometry/presentation rules after equivalent behavior is owned by PublicContactDock. Its footer spacing, Deal rails/story layout, typography, contrast, sticky/scrollytelling, animation and every unrelated homepage rule remain unchanged. platformV7InternationalHomepageFix.test.ts may change only to prove that the compatibility stylesheet no longer owns dock geometry and that the equivalent mobile/desktop/accessibility contract is owned by PublicContactDock; it must retain all unrelated homepage assertions.

apps/web/app/pc-public-entry/platform-v7/home-approved-contact-dock.css is in scope only to retire its homepage-only .pc-public-contact-dock width/position/grid/action-size/action-label/hover/forced-colors presentation rules after equivalent canonical behavior is owned by PublicContactDock. The isolated public-entry page, its data-contact-dock-visual marker, initial PublicContactDock mount, deferred-duplicate suppression and route rewrite remain unchanged. The stylesheet may remain imported as a neutral compatibility marker but must not remain a second dock geometry authority. platformV7PublicLayoutSplit.test.ts may change only to replace assertions for the retired homepage-only dock visual with assertions for canonical PublicContactDock ownership while preserving every unrelated public/protected split, service-worker, route, locale, CSS-loading and fixed-header assertion.

Gekta discovery may hide the canonical website header only after the visitor explicitly enters the immersive chat workspace, where the existing Gekta workspace toolbar becomes the application chrome. Entering or leaving chat must not change account, entitlement, gateway, conversation, consent or billing semantics.

Gekta RU, EN and ZH top-level product routes remain /gekta, /gekta/en and /gekta/zh. Locale navigation may change presentation only; AI gateway requests, entitlement, account session, storage, projects, conversation history and streaming behavior are unchanged.

GektaMobileDrawer and GektaFloatingEntry may change only for responsive geometry, overlay/backdrop weight, safe-area, focus, touch-target, overlap and reduced-motion acceptance. Their destinations, dialog semantics, focus trapping, inert behavior and product-entry authority remain unchanged.

The public login page already uses PublicSiteHeader; it may change only if exact browser evidence proves a shell/spacing/locale defect. Login form submission, password, MFA, next-route, cookie and session semantics are unchanged.

The live /platform-v7/register page may replace only its custom public p0-register-header chrome with PublicSiteHeader and adjust the three listed public-register CSS files for canonical 64px spacing, intrinsic reflow and touch-safe presentation. RegisterFormClientPublic, its props, form submission, field validation, selected role, email verification, statusToken/verify token preservation, onboarding decisions and protected registration authority are unchanged.

The register page's RU/EN/ZH query-locale cycle must preserve existing verify/statusToken query values exactly as the current page does. Canonical-header adoption must not drop, rewrite or expose those tokens beyond the current URL behavior.

The byte-bound /platform-v7/terms and /platform-v7/privacy page source files are immutable in this scope. Their exact bytes, CURRENT_CONSENT_VERSION, consent hashes, API evidence and PostgreSQL whitelist must remain unchanged. Canonical chrome for these routes must be added outside those source artifacts.

PrivacyPortalPanel.tsx is transitively rendered inside the byte-bound Privacy route and is also immutable in this scope. The current consent evidence hashes only app/platform-v7/privacy/page.tsx rather than its imported component graph; changing PrivacyPortalPanel would therefore alter rendered consent content without changing the bound hash. Until consent authority explicitly hashes that transitive content, Phase 3 must not modify the component.

apps/web/app/platform-v7/layout.tsx is in scope only for two presentation-only purposes after the request is already classified as public: (1) wrap the already-public exact routes /platform-v7/terms, /platform-v7/privacy, /platform-v7/oferta and /platform-v7/docs with PublicLinkedSurfaceShell; and (2) replace the inherited public metadata description, keywords and OpenGraph framing that still narrows the platform to a grain-only deal contour with neutral crop/agricultural Deal wording consistent with #5111. LANDING_PATH, AUTH_PATHS, PUBLIC_EXACT_PATHS, PUBLIC_PREFIX_PATHS, ALIAS_EXACT_PATHS, ALIAS_DYNAMIC_PATHS, normalizePath, isPublicPath, isStaffPath, isKnownProtectedPath, verifiedCabinetRole, login/redirect logic and all authorization decisions must remain unchanged.

ContextualSupportOrAssistant.tsx is in scope for one exact presentation/runtime-classification repair only: add /platform-v7/trust to the existing PUBLIC_EXACT public-support set so Trust renders the same PublicPlatformAssistant plus PublicContactDock path as other public pages instead of the private floating AiAssistantPanel/support runtime. No other path, private-workspace test, assistant destination, dialog semantics, account, gateway, entitlement or authorization behavior may change.

The inherited platform-v7 metadata normalization is SEO/presentation only: it may describe product/demand, counterparty, logistics, quality, documents, settlement and exceptions across crop agriculture, but must not introduce provider-connection, deployment, readiness, scale, endorsement or production-state claims. Route-level metadata that is already more specific remains authoritative for its route.

PublicLinkedSurfaceShell is presentation-only. It may render locale-aware canonical public chrome and spacing and, only on the byte-bound Terms/Privacy routes, may hide existing navigation links/cards whose destinations are non-public operational surfaces (/platform-v7/auth, /platform-v7/bank, /platform-v7/profile, /platform-v7/security, /platform-v7/status). It may also hide a route-local navigation-only heading, description or container when, after those non-public links are removed, that container has no remaining public destination or its visible label itself is status/readiness/provider-state navigation copy. This exception is limited strictly to navigation chrome: every substantive legal-policy block and PrivacyPortalPanel must remain visible and byte-identical. The shell must not substitute legal text through pseudo-elements or cloned content, must not create access, and must not change route authority.

For EN/ZH on byte-bound Terms/Privacy, PublicLinkedSurfaceShell may show only a short non-binding notice that the unchanged authoritative legal text below is published in Russian plus links to public support. It must not present a translated summary as the consent artifact or imply that a generated translation carries the bound consent hash.
The About legal/document links may be localized and kept consistent with the active RU/EN/ZH locale. Their destinations remain the existing public Terms, Privacy, Oferta and Docs routes.

The public Docs route may replace its custom page-specific header with the canonical shell and replace demonstration/readiness wording with ordinary capability, document and external-boundary language. It may broaden grain-only explanatory copy where needed for the crop-platform public story, but it must not fabricate EDI, FGIS, bank or provider connectivity.

The public Oferta route may adopt the canonical shell, locale-aware presentation and neutral external-boundary wording. It must preserve the existing non-contractual/no-fabricated-operator boundary and must not become a new legally binding operator offer or fabricate legal requisites.

The superseding #5111 no-status public-copy and scannability rules apply to /platform-v7/trust. apps/web/app/platform-v7/trust/page.tsx may replace the old clone/rebrand document wrapper with a direct RU/EN/ZH Deal-native proof surface using canonical PublicSiteHeader and registration-first public navigation. It may change Trust presentation layout, hierarchy and visitor-facing copy only; the shared apps/web/app/trust/page.tsx source remains immutable, no private/protected data may be exposed, public role choice grants no authority, external systems keep their own subject-matter authority, and Gekta remains explanatory assistance without independent authority to alter a Deal, move money or make a critical decision.

The focused Trust responsive acceptance spec may be added and playwright.acceptance.config.ts may change only to include that exact spec in the existing Design System v8 testMatch. Existing projects, retries, workers, browser coverage, cabinet/auth/security specs and workflow files must not be removed, weakened, skipped or otherwise changed by this authority.

The existing pre-merge Design System v8 acceptance and registration-official specs may be extended only to prove the Phase 3 public presentation contract at the required linked routes and viewports. Workflow files remain unchanged; no test may weaken, skip or replace existing cabinet/auth/security assertions.

The superseding #5111 public-copy rule remains binding: no visitor-facing live/connected/active/pending/ready/verified/synced/passed, maturity/readiness badges, provider-connection badges or equivalent factual current-state marketing UI. Neutral stage, role, document, area and clearly illustrative example labels are permitted.

RU/EN/ZH behavior must be preserved or improved without inventing translations of legally authoritative text as legally binding. If a localized legal explanation is shown, the unchanged authoritative canonical legal source must remain identifiable and consent hashes must remain unchanged.

No workflow, merge gate, production release script, lockfile, tsconfig, middleware authorization, API route, Prisma schema/migration, package, assistant gateway or Gekta entitlement/account source may change.

Responsive acceptance covers 320, 375, 390, 430, 768, 1280 and 1440+ CSS-pixel widths, Chromium and WebKit where existing acceptance supports them, keyboard/focus, reduced motion, safe areas, no horizontal overflow, no clipped words and no fixed/floating overlap.

Pre-merge browser evidence is not production evidence. Final 100/100 remains blocked until the accepted exact SHA is deployed through the existing REG.RU authority and live desktop/mobile RU/EN/ZH human visual acceptance finds no material defect.
forbiddenChanges: production, release, merge or existing security workflows
acceptance: The exact implementation diff is a subset of allowedPaths from this independently accepted governance base.
Source-controlled scope resolution, autopilot guard, exact-head review-gate contract and relevant existing CI pass without workflow changes.
The live registration source keeps RegisterFormClientPublic untouched and preserves verify/statusToken values while using canonical public-site chrome.

The exact SHA-256 bytes of app/platform-v7/terms/page.tsx and app/platform-v7/privacy/page.tsx still match CURRENT_CONSENT_EVIDENCE and the PostgreSQL consent-evidence whitelist after the implementation.
PrivacyPortalPanel.tsx remains unchanged so the rendered Privacy consent surface cannot drift behind an unchanged page-source consent hash.

Terms and Privacy keep all substantive legal-policy prose visible while non-public operational navigation cards and any now-empty or status-oriented navigation-only wrappers are removed from the visitor presentation by the external shell only.

The byte-bound Privacy route no longer visibly advertises the navigation-only ‘Состояние сервисов’/provider-state surface, while its legal-policy blocks and PrivacyPortalPanel remain byte-identical and visible.
Terms, Privacy, Oferta and Docs are presented inside one canonical locale-aware public shell without changing public/protected route classification or any authorization decision.
Inherited platform-v7 metadata no longer describes the public product as grain-only; route classification and authorization source bytes outside metadata/presentation framing remain unchanged.

PublicContactDock is the only source of canonical public contact-dock responsive geometry after implementation: platform-v7-international-home-fix.css, home-approved-contact-dock.css and registration route CSS contain no competing dock width/height/grid/position/action-visibility rules, while all unrelated homepage/public-entry/registration compatibility rules remain unchanged.

Canonical-header pages at mobile widths do not expose the 304-334px three-action contact dock over forms or reading content; they retain one touch-safe Gekta/assistant floating action and keep the underlying support/call destinations unchanged.

Canonical-header pages at >=1180px do not expose the 304-334px horizontal contact dock over form or reading content; all three existing actions remain available as >=44px controls in a narrow vertical rail, with destinations and behavior unchanged.
The Gekta RU/EN/ZH discovery surface uses canonical public-site chrome without breaking the existing immersive chat workspace, mobile drawer, streaming, account or entitlement behavior.

The shared apps/web/app/trust/page.tsx source remains unchanged while /platform-v7/trust is a direct scannable RU/EN/ZH Deal-native proof surface that keeps role/authority, evidence/history, external-system and Gekta boundaries explicit without visitor-facing status/readiness/provider-connection claims.

Trust is classified by ContextualSupportOrAssistant as public and renders the canonical public assistant plus PublicContactDock rather than the private floating AI/support runtime; browser acceptance finds no overlapping interactive targets or WCAG 2.2 target-size collision.
Focused regressions prove no visitor-facing status/readiness/provider-connection marketing language on the changed or wrapped public surfaces.

The ordinary pre-merge browser matrix produces exact-head evidence for the changed linked public surfaces, focused Trust responsive acceptance and registration shell. playwright.acceptance.config.ts may only register the focused Trust spec; workflow files remain unchanged.
Browser evidence at required viewports proves no overflow, clipping, fixed/floating overlap or undersized primary controls and preserves keyboard/reduced-motion behavior.
A completed independent review is bound to the exact current implementation head before merge; owner self-audit alone is insufficient.
Any final production claim requires exact-SHA REG.RU deployment plus live-domain desktop/mobile RU/EN/ZH evidence and human visual review.
